title: First approved COVID-19 vaccine dose is given
summary: Margaret Keenan, aged 90, received the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine in Coventry, the first person given an approved COVID-19 vaccine outside a trial.
reason: mRNA technology let vaccines be developed in under a year.
significance: Mass vaccination saved millions of lives.
place: University Hospital Coventry, England, United Kingdom
wikipedia: COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom
